[b]The communication[/b]
At 10:27pm the Sal-Baliz detected an attempted communication between a device inside one of their hostages cells and an external source. BRING HIM IN HERE NOW! Cried Falah Mahdi, the supreme leader of the Sal-Baliz. Two soldiers came in carrying a starved looking man. This man was a Hydronian Soldier, who was taken hostage 5 years ago, during operation sunscorch. He was declared dead by Hydronia in 2021.
WHO DID YOU CONTACT! Yelled Falah. The man didnt speak. One of the soldiers hit him on the back of his head with a rifle. You better speak up now or things are going to get messy. Falah whispered in his ear. 
I didnt contact anyone, mumbled the man.
Nice try, but that isnt going to work, you should know this by now, said Falah. Just tell us who you spoke to and we wont have to hurt you.
How generous of you, replied the man, sarcastically.
The soldier hit him again.
Fine, Ill tell you. I tried to contact my government to let them know Im still alive, but I couldnt get the signal strong enough.
Thank you, replied Falah whilst his crooked smile spread across his face. Now then, why dont you tell us how you got this device working, he said whilst holding up a broken radio.
You think Im going to tell you that? replied the man.
TELL ME OR ILL KILL YOU!
Ive been wanting to die since I got to this place, youre going to have to think of a better threat than that.
HAVE HIM KILLED! shouted Falah. The soldiers covered the mans head with a black cloth and dragged him away, but the man showed no signs of resistance. He was finally going to be freed from his captives.

[b]Operation Spyglass[/b]
After the recent meeting to discuss the response to the Aviano attack, Hydronia began compiling all of its reports and information on the Sal-Baliz for review. They are all at least 3 years out of date or more, so the government must begin intelligence gathering quickly. The government first wants to find out who is supplying the Sal-Baliz and who they have contact with in different parts of Erene. The government will dispatch undercover agents to various countries to do some investigation. The THEP countries have been notified of who the agents are in their respective country, but any non THEP nations have not been informed, as the government fears that a state sponsor of supplies could be involved. At midnight on March 8th, the agents that are going to operate in THEP countries flew to their destinations. The next day, agents that are set to operate in non THEP countries flew at random points in the day, so that it would be hard for a connection to be drawn between them and the government of Hydronia.
